properties.name: Florida above Lemon
properties.extent: Florida River and tributaries upstream of Lemon Dam, including the reservoir. Terrain-derived approximation to the dam outlet; no downstream Florida River drainage.
properties.source: USGS 3DEP elevation; D8 terrain delineation at Lemon Dam
properties.method: Reproject elevation to UTM 13N at 20m; fill pits/depressions; resolve flats; D8 flow; maximum accumulation within 300m of dam reference -107.66222,37.3825; index-based upstream catchment. Simplified for display.
